items.title: Show HN: One API and MCP Server to Publish to TikTok, Instagram and YouTube
items.zh_title: UGC API：一次调用，把短视频发到全平台
items.zh_oneliner: 一次调用就把同一条视频按各平台规则裁好、定时发到 TikTok、Instagram、Facebook 和 YouTube 的全部账号，还能看哪个平台、哪条文案赢了。

items.title: Show HN: AI Dating photos – can you tell they're AI?
items.zh_title: DatingProfile：以假乱真的 AI 约会头像生成器
items.zh_oneliner: 传几张自拍，一分钟生成 62 种场景的约会头像，还附赠免费的简介、开场白与回复生成器，不用安装。

items.title: Show HN: WhiBoard – A fast Miro alternative with AI diagramming
items.zh_title: WhiBoard：说句话就能画图的 AI 白板
items.zh_oneliner: 用一句话描述想法，让 AI 直接画出流程图、思维导图或系统架构图，再和团队在同一块白板上接着改。

items.title: I built a full-stack web app that connects your vegetable garden to your freezer inventory and AI recipes (PlotToPlate - looking for beta feedback! 🌱❄️)

items.zh_oneliner: 在浏览器里规划菜园、给冷冻食材贴码记效期，再按手头现有的菜让 AI 配菜谱，免安装就能先玩演示版。

items.title: I made a free, open-source Markdown editor that keeps your files GitHub-compatible

items.zh_oneliner: 在浏览器里写 Markdown，文件格式与 GitHub 完全兼容，免费开源、不用注册，离线也能用。

items.title: Simple, shareable todo lists

items.title: Show HN: Softytools – 17 free trading calculators, no signup

items.title: Show HN: Birds as Code

items.title: Show HN: Cppgm compiles C++ to WASM 4x faster than Clang

items.title: Show HN: Treestamp – An editor for project directory trees

items.title: I built a DIY Tax planner - Shows the tax impact of your financial decisions https://taxvant.com/try
